subject: Azure co-sell: Partner Center consent lifecycle + account tiling playbook
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Contoso Corp <seller-eng@contoso.com>, Azure Partner Center Team <pc-team@microsoft.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Azure co-sell: Partner Center consent lifecycle + account tiling playbook

Hi team — looping everyone together to lock the operational playbook for Contoso's Partner Center referrals. Key asks:

1) Confirm consent lifecycle steps we will ask Contoso to follow so PC can route referrals to our field sellers (consent, seller mapping, owner confirmation)
2) Agree on an account tiling approach for Contoso enterprise accounts (how we split net-new vs. existing seller-owned)
3) Confirm what artifacts Microsoft needs and how we exchange them (CSV schema, signed consent form, DocuSign link)

Karthik / Vanessa — can you propose the tiling matrix and routing thresholds? Contoso / PC-team — if you have a preferred data layout for the account list + consent evidence, please attach.

I attached a draft PC consent template and a blank tiling workbook for quick edits. Proposed follow-up: 30-min sync this week.

Thanks,
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
redwood.com
---
Attachments: pc-consent-template.docx (docx), tiling-matrix-v1.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Contoso Corp <seller-eng@contoso.com>, Azure Partner Center Team <pc-team@microsoft.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure co-sell: Partner Center consent lifecycle + account tiling playbook

Kimberly — thanks. Quick proposal to get us unblocked:

- Tiling tiers: Tier A (>$5M ARR) — field seller ownership preserved unless Contoso explicitly relinquishes; Tier B ($500k-$5M) — shared routing with primary contact opt-in; Tier C (<$500k) — default partner-led routing with Redwood follow-up.
- Routing triggers: inbound PC referral > lead score threshold OR Contoso referral flagged as enterprise => require explicit seller consent record in CSV (consent_date + consenting_seller_email).
- Required artifacts: account CSV (columns: account_id, account_name, primary_owner_email, region, ARR_est, consent_date, consent_method), signed consent PDF or DocuSign envelope id.

I'll attach a populated example after we receive Contoso's account list. If PC-team needs a different column order, we can adapt. Also proposing auto-fallback: if consent not present, referral routes to Redwood SDRs for outreach (so we don't lose the opportunity).

Karthik
Senior Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachments: tiling-matrix-v1.xlsx (updated with tier logic)

From: Contoso Corp <seller-eng@contoso.com>

Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 07:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Azure co-sell: Partner Center consent lifecycle + account tiling playbook

Thanks, Kimberly / Karthik — attaching our account list (partial) for the initial pass. Notes:

- File contains 220 accounts; we've marked current Microsoft seller owner where known.
- Our preferred flow is partner-led for mid-market accounts; for Tier A we want seller-owner confirmation before Redwood can accept assigned referrals.
- We'll accept DocuSign consent via the PC-team envelope if you supply the template.

Available for a sync Thu 07/16 10:00-11:00 PT or Fri 07/17 13:00-14:00 PT.

Regards,
Maya Rao
Head of Strategic Alliances, Contoso Corp

Attachments: contoso_account_list.csv (csv)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Contoso Corp <seller-eng@contoso.com>, Azure Partner Center Team <pc-team@microsoft.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure co-sell: Partner Center consent lifecycle + account tiling playbook

Adding a few operational safeguards based on prior PC escalations:

- Ownership disputes: add an "owner_conflict_flag" column in the CSV and require pc-team to surface an owner dispute case id for any contested Tier A account. We'll hold routing for 48 hours pending resolution.
- Escalation path: Contoso -> Redwood GTM (Karthik) -> Microsoft PC escalation queue (cc: pc-team) -> legal if required.
- Data exchange: prefer secure SharePoint link for CSVs (avoid email attachments), and track transfer via HubSpot deal notes and PC ticket ids.

I'll draft a short SOP with the above and a checklist (consent present, owner_email validated, ARR bucket confirmed, fallback routing configured). Sharing the Drive link with the SOP now.

Vanessa
Director, Partner Integrations, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOP-pc-consent-checklist.md (md)

Subject: Re: Azure co-sell: Partner Center consent lifecycle + account tiling playbook

Appreciate the quick turn. Next steps:

1) Contoso to confirm which 40 accounts are Tier A by EOD Mon 07/20 (we'll pause routing for any accounts not confirmed).
2) PC-team: please confirm CSV schema acceptance or propose modifications by Mon 07/20.
3) Karthik / Vanessa: finalize the SOP and the owner_dispute escalations doc; share as Drive doc for comment.
4) I'll send DocuSign envelope using the PC consent template once Contoso confirms Tier A list.

If we agree to these timelines, we'll run a small pilot for the first 60 accounts next week to validate routing and consent capture.

Thanks — Kim
